The '''Surgeons''' was a [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] black ops squad that operated during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Originally a [[Republic Army]] unit under the command of newly-promoted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], the other members of the squad were recruited by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] after their [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|first mission]] to become part of the Special Forces' black ops division. However, they were eventually convicted of war crimes for targeting the families of enemy leaders and imprisoned on [[Berrun]].
